summary: Closed the vote-granting gap: the observer state installs no vote-request handler, so an observer never contributes a vote, while the witness state installs the ordinary vote handler that grants when the vote is free and the candidate's log is at least as up to date. Together with the campaign exclusion this completes the eligibility picture — witnesses are voters that cannot lead, observers take part in neither vote nor campaign, and no leader can rest its election on a node holding no log. Added one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account; noted that a witness's up-to-date comparison depends on its placeholder entries, which were not examined. No execution requested.
